overloadMerges.note: siblingElemName and siblingElemValue are out-parameters filled in with the previous sibling's name/value, not inputs; the mechanical draft parsed them as direction 'in'.

params.name: siblingElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the previous sibling element

params.name: siblingElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the previous sibling element

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the previous sibling of elementRef among its parent's children, for use navigating the children of an XML element; sets OK to 0 before the first sibling.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
